summary: Browse Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline.
page_description: Browse your Zotero collections, read metadata and indexed paper text, and keep papers available offline. Stacks is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Zotero or the Corporation for Digital Scholarship.
release_notes: Renamed from Zotero Reader to Stacks, because Zotero is a registered trademark and this client is independent of the Zotero project.

steps.text: Create a dedicated Zotero API key with read-only access to your personal library.
Copy the numeric user ID shown on the Zotero API key settings page. Stacks asks for it on first launch.
Install the API key on your Kobo under the exact secret name zotero.
Launch Stacks, enter the numeric user ID, and select a collection.
Direct mode reads indexed text. Structured PDF layout, tables, figures, formulas, and OCR require the optional self-hosted conversion service.
